title: Dinosaur Game - GPT Image 2.6 + Claude Fable 5.2
author: FilipeDM
selftext: I created the GIFs using GPT Image 2.6 and asked Claude Fable 5.2 to build a dinosaur game based on them. This is the result.

replies.author: FilipeDM
replies.body: Did you expect anything more from a game made by AI?

replies.author: redcard420
replies.body: seriously, i think this looks cool as fuckk. the exact weird shit only ai would give us, keep going on this project its sick.

comments.body:
I think he's running in circles. He passed that rock earlier. Lol.

Good for you man. If it's something that you enjoy, then make the next one better, improve this one, whatever you want to do. If you had fun making it and don't want to push it further, that's ok too.

comments.author: Honest_Accident_8348
comments.body:
Haha I actually like this.  It’s a cool vibe.  
The two things that bugged me where to perfectly symmetrical background volcanos, and the frozen in a single position rock sprite as he rotated around it.  I’d love to see this again with those fixed
